parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.1x (LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 10 µF p.15 vs NCP1117ST33T3G: 4.7 µF p.9); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 800 mA (p.7) compared to NCP1117ST33T3G at 1000 mA (p.3); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 160% higher on NCP1117ST33T3G (LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 61.6 °C/W p.4 vs NCP1117ST33T3G: 160 °C/W p.2); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ, LM1117I grade) vs NCP1117ST33T3G: 0..125 °C Commercial (0°C to +125°C TJ; use NCP1117IST33T3G for -40°C)); NCP1117ST33T3G cold limit only 0 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) and NCP1117ST33T3G (onsemi, SOT-223-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.1x; Iout,max rating drops >=20%; θJA worsens 160% (thermal derating verification required). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 15.7 °C on LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (θJA 61.6 °C/W) vs 40.8 °C on NCP1117ST33T3G (θJA 160 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.2x ratio (5000 µA (p.8) vs 6000 µA (p.4)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB "Strict 0.3–22 Ohm ESR Window — Unstable With Direct MLCC Ceramic Output Capacitors" (p.15) and NCP1117ST33T3G "Commercial 0°C to +125°C Grade Only — Missing 'I' Prefix Excludes Sub-Zero Operation" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB when lower package θJA (61.6 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose NCP1117ST33T3G when load current exceeds 800 mA (up to 1000 mA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
